title: デビュー戦の後に・カワイイよ広がれ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Curren Chan has finished her debut. When she comes back to the waiting room, she's so calm that it's hard to believe she just ran a race.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Oh! My engagement is looking pretty good! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Remember how I posted on Umastagram right before the race? Look at all the likes and comments I've gotten!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At her insistence, I look at her post.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "I was watching!" "Great race!" "What an amazing debut!"
choice_data_list: Looks like everyone was cheering for you.
Looks like everyone was cheering for you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yep! I'm so happy! Thinking about my fans watching me makes me wanna do whatever I can not to let them down. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: But… I guess I can't make everyone happy. Look at the latest comments.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "Curren was in that race?" "I didn't see her." "Who cares about racing?" "Post your outfits too! ♪"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: In reality, there are more comments from people who aren't interested than there are from people cheering me on. It's only my debut, though, so I guess that's normal enough.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: But… I wanna get more people interested in my running.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: And not just my fans, of course. People who like racing, people who aren't interested yet… I want everyone to notice me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She told me before that she wants everyone to know about "Cute Curren." With this in mind, I have to imagine those last comments were disappointing.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Sooo, I wanna work on increasing my brand for a while!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Sooo, I wanna work on increasing my brand for a while!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I mean… If I'm gonna run, I want tons of people to be actually watching me!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: So first things first—I need people to know that I'm running in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: In any case, we're focusing our training on getting my distance up for the time being, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I figure I can use that time to do some self-promotion too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Since her goals are to earn the Triple Tiara and raise her profile, I guess it's true that we don't have to decide on a race goal for the near future.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I knew you'd understand. ♪ I'll do my best to get my name out there!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I knew you'd understand. ♪ I'll do my best to get my name out there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, our current goal is for us to work together to make her better known while continuing to train!
